title: Christmas Carol Potluck Fellowship
description: Join us for our church potluck on Sunday, December 20th after morning service. Bring a favorite holiday dish inspired by a Christmas song, Christmas tradition or a treasured family recipe. Whether your specialty is cookies, casseroles, pies, appetizers or something that only your family can pronounce, we'd love for you to share it!
location: Victory Baptist Church - 295 Pleasant View Drive, Kittanning, PA 16201
